`rekeyed=3/7 ... total=4 C1_R54_PASS=false`; `7fa9a5e` adds four re-key traces (sections 08,

revisions gives that exact line at `077d431e` and `rekeyed=7/7 ... total=0 C1_R54_PASS=true`
